threats.name: Phishing
threats.description: Messages or websites designed to trick users into revealing passwords, account details or other sensitive information.

threats.name: Fake Job Offers
threats.description: Fraudulent recruitment messages that may request payment, personal information or account credentials.

threats.name: Impersonation Scams
threats.description: Scammers pretending to be banks, companies, government agencies or people you know.

safetyTips.title: Verify the sender
safetyTips.description: Check that the message actually came from the person or organisation it claims to represent.

safetyTips.title: Avoid unknown links
safetyTips.description: Do not open unexpected links before checking where they lead.

safetyTips.title: Be careful with urgency
safetyTips.description: Scammers often pressure users to act immediately before they have time to verify information.
